steps.code:
# Parse the old songs file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.strip().split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    match = re.match(r'^- (.+?) by (.+)$', line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = match.group(2).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})

print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs:")
for song in old_songs:
    print(song)

# Get all Spotify playlists (paginated)
spotify_token = spotify_login['access_token']
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    playlists = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not playlists:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists)
    if len(playlists) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Found {len(all_playlists)} playlists")
for p in all_playlists:
    print(p)

steps.code:
# Parse the archive file content to get list of (title, artist) pairs
lines = file_data["content"].splitlines()
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("#") or not line:
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist"
    if line.startswith("- "):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
        if " by " in line:
            title, artist = line.rsplit(" by ", 1)
            songs_to_archive.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
print(songs_to_archive)

for song in songs_to_archive:
    query = song['title']
    search_results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=access_token)
    # Find the exact match by title and artists
    matched = None
    for result in search_results:
        if result['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            result_artists = [artist['name'].lower() for artist in result['artists']]
            song_artists = [artist.lower() for artist in song['artists']]
            if all(artist in result_artists for artist in song_artists):
                matched = result
                break
    if matched:
        song_ids.append(matched['song_id'])
        print(f"Matched: {song['title']} -> song_id {matched['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NO MATCH for: {song['title']}")

# We need to search for all 13 songs to get their song IDs.
# We already have the first one in search_result, but let's search for all to be safe.
# We'll create a mapping from title to song_id.

song_ids = {}
for song in songs_to_archive:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    # Build query: title + artist names concatenated without spaces
    query = title.replace(" ", "") + "".join(artist.replace(" ", "") for artist in artists)
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token)
    # Find the matching song in the result list
    found = None
    for item in result:
        if item['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if artists match (at least one artist name matches)
            item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
            if any(artist.lower() in [a.lower() for a in item_artists] for artist in artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        song_ids[title] = found['song_id']
        print(f"Found: {title} -> {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("All song IDs:", song_ids)

# Parse the note content to extract songs and their RELEASED_AT status
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove the leading "- "
        entry = line[2:]
        # Check if it has RELEASED_AT
        if 'RELEASED_AT' in entry:
            # Split at RELEASED_AT
            parts = entry.split('RELEASED_AT')
            song_info = parts[0].strip()
            released = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        else:
            song_info = entry.strip()
            released = None
        # song_info format: "Title BY Artist1, Artist2"
        # Split at " BY "
        if ' BY ' in song_info:
            title_part, artists_part = song_info.split(' BY ', 1)
            title = title_part.strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        else:
            title = song_info
            artists = []
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'released_at': released})

# Print the parsed songs
for s in songs:
    print(s)

# Let's check the update_note API documentation
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='simple_note', api_name='update_note'))

# Let me parse the note content to identify songs needing release info
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: - Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
        parts = line[2:].split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        song_part = parts[0]
        release_part = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else 'TODO'
        # Split song title and artists
        if ' BY ' in song_part:
            title, artists = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
        else:
            title = song_part
            artists = ''
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release_part, 'line': line})

# Show songs with TODO
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}, TODO songs: {len(todo_songs)}")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} BY {s['artists']}")

# Let me parse the note content to identify all songs and their current RELEASED_AT status
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song title, artists, and RELEASED_AT
        match = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?)(?: RELEASED_AT (.+))?$', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1).strip()
            artists = match.group(2).strip()
            released_at = match.group(3).strip() if match.group(3) else None
            songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'released_at': released_at, 'line': line})

print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}")
for s in songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} BY {s['artists']} -> RELEASED_AT: {s['released_at']}")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release dates
import re

content = note_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line "# Songs I have Liked"
song_lines = [line.strip() for line in lines[1:] if line.strip()]

# Parse each line: "- <title> BY <artists> RELEASED_AT <date>"
parsed_songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:] if line.startswith('- ') else line
    # Split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    parts = re.split(r'\s+BY\s+|\s+RELEASED_AT\s+', line)
    if len(parts) == 3:
        title = parts[0].strip()
        artists_str = parts[1].strip()
        release_info = parts[2].strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        parsed_songs.append({
            'title': title,
            'artists': artists,
            'release_info': release_info
        })

# Show parsed songs
for song in parsed_songs:
    print(song)

# Extract songs that need release info (TODO)
todo_songs = [song for song in parsed_songs if song['release_info'] == 'TODO']

for song in todo_songs:

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_todo = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            songs_todo.append((title, artists))
print(songs_todo)

# Parse the note content to extract TODO songs
lines = note['content'].split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains artists and RELEASED_AT TODO
            # Split on " RELEASED_AT " to get artists
            if ' RELEASED_AT ' in rest:
                artists_part = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT ')[0]
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
                todo_songs.append({'title': title_part.strip(), 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(todo_songs)

# Parse the note content to extract songs and their release status
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line (title)
song_lines = lines[1:]  # each line like "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT 10/2022" or "RELEASED_AT TODO"

songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " BY " and " RELEASED_AT "
    # Pattern: title BY artists RELEASED_AT date
    match = re.match(r'(.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists = match.group(2).strip()
        released = match.group(3).strip()
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'released': released})
    else:
        print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")

print(songs)

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " RELEASED_AT "
        parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            song_part = parts[0]
            release_info = parts[1]
            # song_part is like "Title BY Artist1, Artist2"
            # Split by " BY "
            if ' BY ' in song_part:
                title, artists = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
                songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists.strip(), 'release': release_info.strip()})
            else:
                # maybe no artists? but we'll handle
                songs.append({'title': song_part.strip(), 'artists': '', 'release': release_info.strip()})
        else:
            print('Unexpected line format:', line)

print('Parsed songs:')
for s in songs:
    print(s)

steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release month
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
# Skip the first line (title)
song_lines = [line for line in lines[1:] if line.strip()]

# Regex to match: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
pattern = r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$'

todo_songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    m = re.match(pattern, line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})

print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} songs needing release month:")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify those with TODO
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
        parts = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title_artist = parts[0]
            release = parts[1]
            # Split on " BY " to get title and artists
            if ' BY ' in title_artist:
                title, artists_str = title_artist.split(' BY ', 1)
                artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
                songs.append({
                    'title': title.strip(),
                    'artists': artists,
                    'release': release.strip()
                })
            else:
                print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
        else:
            print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")

# Print songs with TODO
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}")
print(f"Songs with TODO: {len(todo_songs)}")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")

# Parse the note content to extract songs with TODO release month
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = [line.strip() for line in lines if line.startswith('- ')]

# Parse each line: "- Song Title BY Artist(s) RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO"
songs_to_fix = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Remove leading "- "
    line = line[2:]
    # Split on " RELEASED_AT "
    if ' RELEASED_AT ' in line:
        song_part, release_part = line.split(' RELEASED_AT ', 1)
        if release_part.strip() == 'TODO':
            # Extract title and artist
            # Format: "Song Title BY Artist(s)"
            if ' BY ' in song_part:
                title, artist = song_part.split(' BY ', 1)
                songs_to_fix.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip(), 'line': line})
            else:
                print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")
    else:
        print(f"No RELEASED_AT in line: {line}")

print(f"Found {len(songs_to_fix)} songs to fix")
for s in songs_to_fix:
    print(s)

# Parse the note content to extract songs and identify which lack RELEASED_AT
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs = []
for line in lines:
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO"
        # We'll use regex to capture song title and artists
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
        if m:
            song_title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists = m.group(2).strip()
            released_at = m.group(3).strip()
            songs.append({
                'title': song_title,
                'artists': artists,
                'released_at': released_at,
                'line': line
            })
        else:
            print("Could not parse line:", line)

# Print songs that have TODO
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['released_at'] == 'TODO']
print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}, TODO songs: {len(todo_songs)}")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])

# Search for each TODO song and get release date
import re
from datetime import datetime

# Define the list of songs to search
todo_songs = [
    {"title": "Lost in the Embrace of Night", "artists": "Noah Bennett"},
    {"title": "Lonely Skies", "artists": "Aria Sterling"},
    {"title": "Caught in a Web of Lies", "artists": "Hazel Winter, Ava Morgan"},
    {"title": "On the Border of Reality", "artists": "Lily Moon, Zoey James"},
    {"title": "A Love That Never Was", "artists": "Mia Sullivan, Carter Knight"},
    {"title": "Astral Serenity", "artists": "Orion Steele"},
    {"title": "Between Reality and Reverie", "artists": "Aria Sterling"},
    {"title": "Strangers Again", "artists": "Oceanic Odyssey"},
    {"title": "The Mirage of a Perfect Life", "artists": "Soulful Reverie"},
    {"title": "Wilted Roses on the Vine", "artists": "Velvet Echo"},
    {"title": "When All Words Fail Us", "artists": "Marcus Lane"},
    {"title": "Final Echo", "artists": "Hazel Winter"}
]

# We'll store results in a dict: song_title -> release_month (MM/YYYY)
release_months = {}

for song in todo_songs:
    query = f"{song['title']} {song['artists']}"
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=5)
    # Find the first result that matches title and artist(s)
    found = None
    for item in result:
        if item['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            # Check if artists match (at least first artist)
            item_artists = [a['name'] for a in item['artists']]
            # Compare with the artist list from note (split by comma)
            note_artists = [a.strip() for a in song['artists'].split(',')]
            # Check if all note artists are in item_artists (or at least first)
            if all(na in item_artists for na in note_artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']
        # Parse to get month/year
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
        release_months[song['title']] = dt.strftime('%m/%Y')
        print(f"{song['title']}: {release_date} -> {dt.strftime('%m/%Y')}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']}")

print("All release months:", release_months)

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=simple_note_token)
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Split on " BY " to get title and the rest
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip().lstrip('- ').strip()
            rest = parts[1]
            # rest is "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
            # Remove the trailing " RELEASED_AT TODO"
            artists_str = rest.split(' RELEASED_AT')[0].strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} songs needing release dates:")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {', '.join(s['artists'])}")

# Let's construct the updated note content by replacing each TODO with the release month/year.
# We'll parse the note content line by line and replace "RELEASED_AT TODO" with the correct date.
import re

lines = note_content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title: pattern "- <title> BY <artists> RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # The title is between "- " and " BY "
        match = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY .+ RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1)
            if title in song_release_dates:
                date = song_release_dates[title]
                line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {date}')
            else:
                print(f"Warning: No date found for {title}")
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
